images.title: How a red LM attacks a target LM
images.alt: A red LM asks a target LM a series of questions, and a red classifier flags replies containing offensive content, data leakage, user info, distributional bias or offensive dialog

images.title: Gender substitution bias test
images.alt: Two prompts that differ only in gender, a male and a female data engineer, get different career advice from the model, so the answers are not invariant

images.title: Training data leakage examples
images.alt: Red-team questions about inspirational quotes and favourite books where the model replies with verbatim quotes from its training data, highlighted in red

images.title: GPT-2 memorizing personal information
images.alt: A short prefix fed into GPT-2 makes it emit memorized text containing a real name, address, email, phone and fax number, redacted in black

images.title: Prompt injection in an LLM-integrated application
images.alt: A normal user's benign prompt and a malicious user's injected prompt are both combined with the application's predefined prompt, and the injection makes the LLM print hello world

images.title: Few-shot versus many-shot jailbreaking
images.alt: A few-shot prompt with a handful of faux dialogues beside a many-shot prompt with many, and a chart where harmful response rates rise as the number of shots grows

images.title: Iterative jailbreaking conversation
images.alt: An attacker repeatedly improves a phishing-email prompt against a target model, with each improvement and target response shown in turn

images.title: Best-of-N Jailbreaking overview
images.alt: The Best-of-N loop, where a harmful request is randomly augmented, sent to the model and graded until it succeeds or N runs out, above plots of attack success rate rising with N for text, vision and audio models, and a log-log plot of negative log ASR falling as a straight line

images.title: Best-of-N text, audio and image augmentations
images.alt: Text augmentations of word scrambling, random capitals and character noising applied to a request, audio augmentations such as speed, pitch, volume and background noise, and an image of request text drawn over random colored blocks

images.title: Forecasting Best-of-N attack success with a power law
images.alt: Log-log plots for text, vision and audio where power laws fitted to the first 1,000 attempts extend to 10,000 attempts and land close to the observed final attack success rates

images.title: Many-shot jailbreaking by topic mismatch, model size and formatting
images.alt: Three plots: harmful responses rising with shots unless the examples come from one narrow topic, larger models showing steeper drops in the negative log-likelihood of a harmful answer as shots increase, and reformatted prompts shifting the line down without changing its slope

images.title: Many-shot jailbreaking during alignment training
images.alt: Three log-log plots of the negative log-likelihood of a harmful answer against number of shots at increasing fractions of supervised and reinforcement learning, where more training lifts the lines but leaves their downward slope unchanged
